archive.catalogue_description: Welcome to Zay’s One Window Challenge! where your survival skills will be put to the ultimate test. In this intense and fast-paced map, there is only one window for the zombies to breach, but don’t let that fool you. The relentless waves of undead will keep you on your toes as you fend them off from a single, fortified position. Features : Single Window Defense : All zombies enter through one window, creating a concentrated and high-intensity battle. Tight Quarters : Limited space means limited mobility. Stay sharp and manage your resources wisely. Power-Ups and Mystery Box : Strategically placed power-ups and a Mystery Box offer a fighting chance to survive the onslaught. Perks : Enhance your survival chances with classic perks including Quick Revive, Juggernog, Double Tap, and Speed Cola. Increasing Difficulty : As rounds progress, the challenge intensifies with faster and stronger zombies. Tips for Survival: Work with your team to cover the window and manage your ammo. Utilize power-ups and perks effectively to maintain your defense. Use the Mystery Box strategically to equip yourself with powerful weapons.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it.
